about: vstack skills bundled as Loadout built-ins. .github/scripts/vstack_sync.py reads this list and keeps the folders, CREDITS.md and src/builtin_skills.rs in step with it. always_on skills ride in full in every Code tab session; the rest load with the skill tool. A sync bundles a new upstream skill that is in neither list, and its PR then waits for a person.

exclude.bag-and-tag: vstack's own release ritual: it bumps plugin manifests and checks installers other repos don't have
exclude.ketchup-video: renders a slide video and embeds it in chat; the app has no video pipeline for it
exclude.recall: rebuilds context from Cursor's agent-transcripts folder, which the app doesn't keep
exclude.reflect: writes skill edits into Cursor's skill folders, not the app's skill store
exclude.setup-vstack: installs vstack into a coding agent; the app ships these skills itself
exclude.stageshow: ships a 2 MB React kit of example screens beside its text
exclude.updater: runs its 52 KB scripts/updater.py from the skill folder, which is over the skill tool's file size and has no folder on disk to run from
